snippet.title: Moadra | Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Endure... Evolve... or die. Prepare for the unknown as exploring the perilous depths of the forgotten planet Protea VI awaits you.

Step into the boots of Lieutenant Moadra Meras when this dark sci-fi Metroidvania game launches on PlayStation 5, XBOX Series X|S, Nintendo Switch, and PC on 22 October 2026!

Wishlist on your favourite platform!

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1713730/Moadra/

PlayStation 5: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10019042

XBOX Series X|S: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/moadra/9ngcbvvckbr5

Nintendo Switch: https://www.nintendo.com/us/store/products/moadra-switch/
